references.text: The Lord's appointed feasts (מוֹעֲדֵי) are also mentioned here as holy assemblies that Israel must keep.
A summary of the festival offerings to be brought at the appointed times, in addition to vows and freewill offerings.
Describes freewill offerings (נְדָבָה) and vow offerings (נֶדֶר) mentioned in Numbers 29:39.
Laws concerning vow offerings and freewill offerings, burnt offerings, and peace offerings to the Lord.
Instructions regarding grain offerings and drink offerings that are to accompany burnt offerings and other sacrifices.
The beginning of the sacrificial laws concluded in 29:39, with instructions about offerings at appointed times.
Mentions burnt offerings, fellowship offerings, tithes, vow offerings, freewill offerings, and peace offerings to be brought to the Lord.
Instructions to bring all offerings, including vows and freewill gifts, to the place the Lord chooses.
Freewill offerings (נִדְבָה) are mentioned in connection with the Feast of Weeks.
King Hezekiah urges the people to bring fellowship offerings and thank offerings, as well as freewill offerings, to the house of the Lord.
After returning from exile, they resume burnt offerings, new moon offerings, festival offerings, and freewill offerings.
